ability.duringCombat: Add +1 to this card's value for each other dog in the defender's zone.

ability.plain: Target 1 fighter within 2 spaces. If Lucy is non-adjacent to the defender, the value of this card is 5 instead.
ability.duringCombat: If defender is adjacent to Piper, add +1 to this card's value.

ability.plain:
Piper moves up to 5 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters.
Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter she moved through.
Gain 1 action.

Move Piper up to 4 spaces.
Each enemy fighter who began the turn adjacent to Piper must move up to 2 spaces toward her if able.
Piper may keep any toy she is carrying until the end of your next turn.

ability.afterCombat: Move each dog up to 1 space.
ability.immediately: If Lucy and Piper are in the same zone, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

ability.afterCombat: Piper may move up to 2 spaces.
ability.duringCombat: If Piper started the turn non-adjacent to the defender, the value of this card is 5 instead.

ability.afterCombat: If Piper won the combat, she may keep any toy she is carrying until the end of your next turn.
ability.duringCombat: If Piper moved 4 or more spaces this turn, the value of this card is 6 instead.

ability.plain:
Lucy may pick up any toy in her zone. She keeps any toy she is carrying until the end of your next turn.
Shuffle 1 card from your discard pile back into your deck, then draw 1 card.

ability.afterCombat: Defender recovers 2 health. If Lucy and Piper are adjacent, recover 1 health instead.
If Lucy won the combat, gain 1 action.

ability.plain:
You may move either dog adjacent to the other dog.
Gain 1 action.

ability.afterCombat: If Lucy lost the combat, deal 1 damage to all adjacent fighters. Lucy may move up to 1 space.
If Lucy and Piper are in different zones, draw 1 card.
ability.immediately: If Lucy and Piper are in the same zone, you may BOOST this card.

ability.afterCombat: Lucy may move to any space in her zone.
ability.immediately: Reduce the value of your opponent's card by 2.

ability.plain:
Move each dog up to 4 spaces.
Draw 2 cards.
Gain 1 action.

abilities.text:
During combat, if Lucy is carrying a toy, effects on Lucy cards cannot be canceled.

At the end of your turn, if Lucy and Piper are not in the same zone, draw 1 card.

During combat, if Piper is carrying a toy, effects on Piper cards cannot be canceled.

Piper gains +1 movement when carrying a toy.
